dragology-0.2.0.iife.js

One browser file, made on 2026-11-09 from npm packages so that the page needs no build step:

  npm install dragology@0.2.0 react@19 react-dom@19 esbuild
  entry.js:
    export * from "dragology";
    export { default as React } from "react";
    export { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
  esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=Dragology --minify \
    --legal-comments=none --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --outfile=dragology-0.2.0.iife.js

It defines one global, Dragology: the exports of dragology, plus React and createRoot.
Dragology: https://declarative-dragging.github.io/  https://github.com/declarative-dragging/dragology
The file contains these packages. The licence text of each follows.

  dragology 0.2.0  MIT
  react 19.3.1  MIT
  react-dom 19.3.1  MIT
  scheduler 0.28.0  MIT
  immer 11.2.9  MIT
  lodash-es 4.18.1  MIT

  d3-interpolate 3.0.2  ISC
